reason: Replace the invalid adjacency-preserving C031 null with a destructive null while refusing to rescore the already exposed C031 PMF as confirmatory evidence.

holdout.selection_rule: use pmf.dat if present; otherwise PARSE_FAIL without substituting another numeric target

analysis_panel.rule: scan file order and retain the first six primary-coordinate bins containing >=20 finite-energy secondary-coordinate samples; this deterministic panel is fixed before values are inspected
analysis_panel.reason: keeps the holdout computationally bounded while preventing manual selection of visually favorable bins

branch_detector.local_minimum: energy lower than both immediately adjacent finite secondary-grid samples
branch_detector.near_global: minimum is within 1.2 energy units of the lowest finite energy in that primary bin
branch_detector.barrier: maximum finite energy between pair exceeds the higher-energy minimum by >=0.6 energy units
branch_detector.bin_pass: at least one pair satisfies all criteria
branch_detector.first_break: earliest panel bin starting a >=3-bin persistent branch

destructive_null.method: for each primary bin independently, permute finite energy values across fixed secondary-coordinate positions using SHA256('C032' || primary_value || permutation_index || secondary_index) ordering
destructive_null.destroy: native secondary-coordinate adjacency between energy values
destructive_null.score: maximum consecutive bin-pass run in the six-bin panel
destructive_null.pass_requirement: native score >=3 and strictly greater than the 95th percentile of null scores
destructive_null.tie_rule: a tie at the null 95th percentile is FAIL

claim_if_pass: Within this holdout panel, native 2D adjacency contains branch topology not explained by each bin's energy multiset alone; a one-coordinate projection loses branch identity in that region.
next_if_pass: transport the identical frozen detector to an independently authored viral free-energy/trajectory dataset and then run a post-result prior-art killer sweep.
